Fit a group embedding at a fixed alpha with several random restarts

fit_group_embedding_restarts_at_alpha.Rd

Fits n_restarts independent, randomly-initialized embeddings at a fixed dimensionality d and Student-t/crowd-kernel shape alpha, keeping whichever restart achieves the lowest test loss – the same "several random seeds, keep the best" rule run_group_embedding_from_list uses, but at an arbitrary alpha rather than the crowd-kernel default (\(\alpha = 1\)). This is the production "final-final" fit meant to run after estimate_group_alpha has already determined alpha, as the last step of run_group_embedding_workflow – on data that has had the alpha-profiling sub-pool folded back into training via fold_alpha_test_to_train, since that sub-pool's only job (estimating alpha) is already done by this point.

Usage

fit_group_embedding_restarts_at_alpha(
  triplet_list,
  d,
  alpha,
  n_restarts = 5L,
  seed = 1L,
  max_epochs = 50000L,
  tolerance = 1e-04,
  tol_window = 10000L,
  device = NULL,
  norm_penalty = 0,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

triplet_list

A list of per-participant data frames, as returned by get.combined, with a usable sampleSet column (see prepare_triplet_matrices).

d

Embedding dimensionality.

alpha

The fixed Student-t/crowd-kernel shape parameter to fit under, typically estimate_group_alpha(...)$alpha.

n_restarts

Number of independent random restarts. Default 5L.

seed

Base integer seed; restart r uses seed + (r - 1) * 1000, the same restart-seed formula used throughout this package's Condor workflows and run_group_embedding_workflow's own step 2.

max_epochs, tolerance, tol_window, device, norm_penalty

Same meaning as the matching arguments of run_group_embedding_from_list.

verbose

Logical; print one progress line per restart. Default TRUE.

Value

A named list:

embedding

Numeric matrix, the winning restart's embedding (item names as row names, dim_0/dim_1/... columns).

loss

That restart's test loss.

epoch

Epoch at which that restart's training stopped.

history

That restart's per-epoch training history.

restart

Which restart (1-based) was kept.

restarts

Data frame with one row per restart: restart, seed, loss – for inspecting the full spread, not just the winner.

Details

Like estimate_group_alpha, this bypasses train_embedding's CKL-only (\(\alpha = 1\)) wrapper and calls the underlying _fit_offline() Python entry point directly (noise_model = "TSTE", module_kwargs = list(module__alpha = alpha)). Restarts are deliberately not warm-started from anything – the point of using several random seeds is to search different local optima, which a shared warm start would mostly defeat.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
grp <- run_group_embedding_from_list(icon_triplets, d = 3L)
joint <- estimate_group_alpha(icon_triplets, warm_start = grp$embedding)
folded <- fold_alpha_test_to_train(icon_triplets, joint$alpha_test_rows)
final_final <- fit_group_embedding_restarts_at_alpha(
  folded, d = 3L, alpha = joint$alpha, n_restarts = 5L
)
final_final$embedding
} # }
